scientific_integrity: Proof based on facet sign-counts and tangent-cone spherical masses; finite exact arithmetic and Monte Carlo are supporting checks, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to nonintersecting original-face-parallel tetrahedral corner cuts, coupled Haar-uniform orthogonal views; no uniqueness of tetrahedron from solid angles or general independent audit. The fully truncated special case was already known.
title: The joint shadow-count law of all partial tetrahedral corner truncations
